messages:
Amy (Sales Eng): Heads-up: Regional fintech wants a hosted POC demo Tue 10:00 ET. They need a short burst window for automated trades + screen share. Ask: 300 QPS for a 24h window, IP allowlist, and scoped keys with auto-rotate. Can we support?
Diego (Solutions): Yes, hosted scoped keys + a temporary quota bucket is the fastest. We can set per-key QPS up to 500 for short windows. Recommend: 300 QPS, TTL 24h for the main demo key, and 2h session keys for each observer.
Priya (SRE): Need the customer egress IPs (CIDRs ideally). Also confirm whether their load generator uses a cloud NAT or per-instance IPs. If NAT, provide NAT ranges.
Amy (Sales Eng): They said AWS runners with NAT Gateway. I'll ask for the NAT CIDR blocks and a contact.
Diego (Solutions): Implementation notes for ops: 1) create temp quota bucket named demos/fintech-<date>; 2) issue scoped key bound to that bucket with qps=300; 3) set key TTL=86400; 4) add allowed_cidrs; 5) tag token with customer_id and demo_id.
Diego (Solutions): Example request to internal token service:

```
POST /api/internal/scoped-keys
{
  "parent":"sk-prod-XXXX",
  "bucket":"demos/fintech-2026-03-23",
  "qps":300,
  "ttl":86400,
  "allowed_cidrs":["54.210.0.0/16"],
  "meta":{"owner":"amy@redwood.com","demo":"trade-demo"}
}
```

Diego (Solutions): Response will include token, id, and expiry. Ops adds bucket quota cap e.g., tokens=1e6 to avoid hitting global quotas.
Priya (SRE): Monitoring: enable token-level metrics, set alert if error_rate > 0.8% for 5m or p95 > 400ms. We'll also run a 15m smoke at 50% of target qps before the demo.
Amy (Sales Eng): Can we do IP allowlist + referer / cert pinning? Customer asked for extra guard rails.
Priya (SRE): We support IP allowlist natively. Referer header is not secure alone. We can require mTLS for Private only; for hosted we can do IP + scoped keys + short TTL.
legal-bot: FYI: For demo commitments > 24h we usually need a simple amendment. I'll draft if the customer expects a billed Dedicated trial.
Amy (Sales Eng): They want hosted only for now; no billing change. Good.
ops-bot: Note: when provisioning, create an audit ticket in JIRA: RED-DEVOPS-POC and attach the signed IP allowlist from the customer.
Diego (Solutions): Curl example for demo runner:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCOPED_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"healthcheck"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/completions
```

Diego (Solutions): If we see sustained errors, plan B is to reduce qps per key and distribute across two scoped keys to spread load. We can also fall back to a lower-cost model with same API signatures.
Priya (SRE): Ops checklist: add allowed CIDRs to frontend ACL, attach key tag for logs, create temporary cost center for demo usage, schedule auto-revoke at TTL, and confirm alerting. I'll approve ACL changes once CIDRs are provided.
Amy (Sales Eng): I'll collect NAT CIDRs and an SLA contact (they asked for an on-call during the demo).
legal-bot: Attached standard POC addendum link: https://redwood.example.com/legal/poc-addendum. Will send if needed.
Amy (Sales Eng): Thanks all — target provision Fri 08:00 ET. I will post CIDRs by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (SRE): Copy — queuing the smoke test window and alerting rules.
ops-bot: Created JIRA RED-DEVOPS-POC-4321 and assigned to @Priya. Remember to upload customer signed IP list.
Amy (Sales Eng): Closing loop: contact is josh@fintech.io. Expect CIDRs sent by 2026-03-22.
